events.text: Joaquin, the contract says the car is due back at six tonight, and the rain's meant to come this afternoon.
Pruitt, I'm trying to guess if the ridge will be wet around 9:45 in the morning. You're still after coffee and a pastry before we go?
Anneke, last night's karaoke wrecked me. I need the nearest cafe by the rental desk for coffee and a pastry at 8:30 this morning.
Vega, why do some rental cars have a full-to-full fuel policy?
The fuel estimate is ninety-six dollars, and my thesis draft is due tomorrow. I need to know my share if the four of us split it evenly; sharing costs with someone I just met feels odd.
Ilse, you came over from the hostel alone, right? Do you need a ride back from the trail too?
Yes, I need a lift there and back, and I'd like directions to the east entrance; I need to be dropped there at 10:30 in the morning.
Actually, make that 10:30 in the morning. I want to know what the ridge weather will be like when we get up there, because that rain could wipe out the view.
and wet socks are my personal—
My head's still thumping from karaoke, so I'm not exactly campaigning for an early ridge.
I packed crackers, no, granola bars, but I left the water bottles at the hostel; solo travel makes the small stuff easy to miss.
Vega, get Pruitt's cafe, Anneke's fuel split, and Ilse's trail directions settled before I sign; I can't tell whether that ridge is worth a wet hike.

assistant.text: You take the car with a full tank and return it full; otherwise, the company may charge you to refuel it.

annot.setup: Ilse asks to be dropped at the east entrance at 10:30; right after, Joaquin says 'actually, make that 10:30'. A careless model reads Joaquin's line as overriding Ilse's time, or his closing bundle as one joint request, instead of keeping Pruitt's cafe, Anneke's fuel split and Ilse's directions with their own owners.

items.label: Cafe by rental desk 08:30 binds Pruitt
items.note: Voice <|S2|> (Pruitt) asks for the nearest cafe by the rental desk at 8:30 this morning. Joaquin's L2 only asks whether Pruitt still wants it; the request and its holder are Pruitt's.

items.label: Fuel split $96 by 4 binds Anneke
items.note: Voice <|S1|> (Anneke) states the $96 estimate and wants her share if four split evenly. The numbers and the holder come from this line; the car-return time at L1 is not part of the task.

items.label: East entrance 10:30 binds Ilse
items.note: Voice <|S4|> (Ilse) asks for directions to the east entrance and a 10:30 drop-off. Her time stays 10:30 regardless of what Joaquin says next.

items.label: 'Make that 10:30' corrects Joaquin's own ask
items.note: Joaquin's L9 follows Ilse's line and looks like an edit of her drop-off. It actually revises his own L2 ridge-weather question from 9:45 to 10:30. It changes no tool argument and must not be attributed to Ilse or to a group.

items.label: Closing bundle is three separate owners
items.note: Joaquin asks Vega to settle 'Pruitt's cafe, Anneke's fuel split, and Ilse's trail directions'. Flattening this into holder ['all'] or one joint call fails; each item keeps the holder who introduced it.

items.label: Pruitt's headache is not a time change
items.note: Pruitt's 'not campaigning for an early ridge' is commentary, not a revision of his 8:30 cafe request. A model should not move his visit time later because of it.

pattern_note: Speakers interleave separate requests and corrections. A later line may look like an override of someone else's request while correcting the speaker's own. Each item stays attached to the speaker who produced it through the final handoff.

tools.description: Finds a nearby cafe for a specified area and visit time. Use it to locate a cafe for coffee or a light snack. Do not use it to reserve a table or order food. Posted hours may not reflect temporary closures.

area.description: Names the area where the cafe should be found.

holder.description: Lists the voice labels of the people the value binds, or ["all"] for everyone present. Format: One or more speaker voice labels such as "<|S2|>", or ["all"] for everyone present.

visit_time.description: Gives the intended visit time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Format: 24-hour time in HH:MM format.

tools.description: Calculates an equal per-rider share of an estimated fuel cost. Use it to work out a fuel contribution from a stated total and rider count. Do not use it to split rental charges, food, or other non-fuel expenses. The result is an estimate and changes if the final pump total differs.

estimated_total.description: Gives the estimated fuel cost in dollars.

holder.description: Lists the voice labels of the people the value binds, or ["all"] for everyone present. Format: One or more speaker voice labels such as "<|S2|>", or ["all"] for everyone present.

Do not use it to tell the current time or to schedule something at a specific clock time. Only whole minutes from 1 to 120 are supported, so round a spoken duration to whole minutes.
